data.name: BakeRotationDescription
data.value:
Creates a copy of the model used by this asset with the Entity rotation applied directly to the model. The asset will use the newly rotated model, and its Entity rotation values will be reset to (0, 0, 0). This function only works with Model assets, not Model Info assets.
Useful for: - Rotating platforms that follow Move Points and face the direction of movement, allowing you to change their movement direction. - Rotating Teeter-Totter type platforms to change their tilt direction. - Rotating TRACK assets used for slides.
This function creates a copy of the model, increasing the archive's file size. If the archive becomes too large, the game may fail to load. The original model will not be removed. You can delete it manually if it is no longer used by any other assets.

data.name: BakeScaleDescription
data.value:
Creates a copy of the model with the Entity scale applied directly to the model. The asset will use the newly scaled model, and its Entity scale values will be reset to (1, 1, 1). This function works with both Model and Model Info assets.
Useful for: - Avoiding collision glitches: Collidable assets normally have glitchy collision when scaled non-uniformly through their Entity scale values (when X, Y, and Z are not equal). - Scaling NPCs: Most NPC and enemy asset types do not handle Entity scale values properly. Since these assets use Model Info, this function creates a scaled copy of the Model Info asset so you can use the scaled NPC or enemy without relying on the Entity scale values. The Model Info scale is a field which you can also edit yourself in the Model Info asset editor later.
This function creates a copy of the model, increasing the archive's file size. If the archive becomes too large, the game may fail to load. The original model will not be removed. You can delete it manually if it is no longer used by any other assets.
